mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, an Elder Impulse System transition into green or red on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies agreement between trend slope and momentum acceleration; follow the newly aligned color for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when current color becomes green after a non-green valid color; short when current color becomes red after a non-red valid color
mechanism.why_distinct: HVEIS requires simultaneous sign agreement of the 13-period EMA slope and MACD histogram slope. It is a two-component transition state rather than a MACD-line crossover, price band/channel, volume force, oscillator, OI, funding, premium, or Gross9 state primitive.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, while dual trend/momentum agreement suppresses isolated noisy turns
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour dual-slope color-transition clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.trend: 13-period close EMA, adjust=false, minimum 13 consecutive valid bars; slope=current-prior EMA
features.macd: 12-period close EMA minus 26-period close EMA; 9-period EMA signal of valid MACD; histogram=MACD-signal
features.color: green when trend slope>0 and histogram slope>0; red when both<0; neutral otherwise
features.transition: current green after non-green or current red after non-red, requiring consecutive valid states
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Elder Impulse color transition under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no EMA/MACD period, smoothing, slope, color, transition, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.fixed_definition: 13-period EMA slope plus standard MACD(12,26,9) histogram slope; green when both rise, red when both fall, neutral otherwise
external_basis.selection_use: published components, periods, color logic, and direction only; no incidence or outcomes
